title: Robin nullity in mode $|k|=1$ and asymptotic radius of the critical spherical catenoid
summary: Medvedev proved that the critical spherical catenoid $Sigma_a$, the rotationally symmetric free boundary minimal annulus in a geodesic ball $B^3(r(a))$ in $H^3$ from the family of Mori and do Carmo-Dajczer, has Morse index at least 4, and conjectured equality. For each $a>1/2$ we establish three analytic results about $Sigma_a$. (I) Robin nullity and index in mode $|k|=1$.
